text: Freedom House has adopted the case of Tatiana Kouzina, a Belarusian civil society researcher imprisoned by the Lukashenka government, which the organization describes as systematically imprisoning independent experts and dissenting voices to eliminate credible sources of information outside state control.

Apple has sent threat notifications to users it suspects have been targeted by spyware since 2021, alerting them via email, iMessage, and account banners — a system Access Now has documented as a key tool for identifying state-sponsored spyware campaigns against journalists, activists, and others.
